caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet prominently placed in the upper left to center portion of the image. The bonnet has a deep blue segment forming the back and upper crown, with visible shading to indicate folds and gathered fabric. The front brim of the bonnet is pink with a diamond cross-hatch pattern, and two wide pink ribbon ties extend downward from beneath the brim. The background is off-white and mostly blank. To the right beneath the main bonnet illustration are two smaller, lightly sketched outlines of bonnets, side by side, featuring similar shapes and brim patterns, but only rendered in pencil without colors or shading.
title: Bonnet
